stage_b_v1.why: One psalm in two languages. The camera holds still and reverent while the Scottish chaplain reads (British and Highlanders on the left), then on 'German' it travels slowly right across the gap to the German side, the way the psalm passed from one army to the other. The script's centred push toward 'the chaplain and the young German' cannot work on this picture: it is a symmetric group with no chaplain in its centre.

seen.what: Symmetrical burial at sunrise: British and Scottish soldiers bare-headed on the left, Germans on the right, three graves with crosses and candles in the centre, braziers in both trench walls, wire posts in the near corners; no chaplain in the centre.
